description: Change an XML element: retag it, replace its text, add, edit or delete attributes (Structure pane menu > New Attribute; Edit and Delete on an attribute), or move it before or after another element or into one

element.description: An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

move.description: Move the element in the structure: give both to and reference

reference.description: An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

to.description: before or after the reference element, or as its first (start) or last (end) child

setAttributes.description: Attributes to add or change, as { name: value }

tag.description: New tag for the element (created if missing)

name: edit_xml_element
title: Edit XML Element
